title: ScholarCitationArtifact
description: Captures what a scholar says about a text, passage, concept, or historiographical issue. Separates the scholar's claim from the source they discuss.

source_id.description: source_id of the scholarly secondary source

bibliographic_source_id.description: source_id of the scholarly work making the claim

cited_work.description: Primary text or topic the scholar is discussing

citation_context.description: What discussion surrounds this claim in the scholar's text

exact_quote.description: Short direct quote if within fair use; must include page_or_location

historiographical_angle.description: Which historiographical school or debate this claim belongs to (e.g. Yates thesis, Copenhaver revision, Hanegraaff constructionism)
